subject: Renewal + Expansion: staged uplift, co-term alignment, and one-time credit options
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@cobaltai.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + Expansion: staged uplift, co-term alignment, and one-time credit options

Hi Marta — great speaking yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together three pragmatic options that keep you within the same SLA and let you ramp additional capacity mid-term without re-architecting your integration. Attached: draft SOW and a usage snapshot from October so you can see the starting point.

Option 1 (Staged top-up + co-term):
- Add 250k token units now (effective today), billed pro-rata for the remainder of the contract term, then annualize at next renewal.
- No change to base rate; one-time setup fee waived.

Option 2 (Upfront uplift + volume band):
- Increase committed units by 40% and receive 12% blended discount on the uplifted portion.
- Proration applies immediately; co-term aligns at next renewal date (no double-billing).

Option 3 (One-time credit + short-term burst):
- Offer a one-time $10,000 usage credit to cover the spike through Q1; maintain current commit.
- If sustained usage > 30% over baseline for two consecutive months, commit will be revisited (we can convert credits into uplift).

Quick ask: which option looks closest to your procurement preferences? If you want, we can send a one-page amendment and a DocuSign link for the path you pick and include the credit as a negotiated concession.

Thanks — Im looping Jordan and Ben for internal approval on the discount language and credit mechanics.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_v2.pdf (PDF, 98KB)]
[Attachment: usage-snapshot-oct2026.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@cobaltai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + Expansion: staged uplift, co-term alignment, and one-time credit options

Kimberly — thanks for this and for the clear options. A few clarifying questions from procurement/engineering: 

1) For Option 1, what would the pro-rate look like if we add 250k units on Nov 27 with a contract term that renews Apr 30? Please show the dollar math (monthly run-rate and pro-rated charge).
2) Option 2 sounds promising; can you confirm the blended 12% discount applies only to the incremental units and whether that discount persists after the co-term annualization?
3) On Option 3, the team prefers credits only if they do not impact SLA credits/backstop language — confirm that usage credits are purely monetary and do not alter performance guarantees.

Procurement also asked whether Redwoods can put a 30-day cancellation window into the amendment for the uplifted tranche in case our usage normalizes.

Wed like to move quickly; if you can give a recommended default and a sample amendment, procurement can sign the one-pager and well send a PO.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Cloud Ops, CobaltAI
[procurement@cobaltai.com]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal + Expansion: staged uplift, co-term alignment, and one-time credit options

Jordan / Ben — Marta asked for concrete numbers and one protective clause (30-day cancel window) for procurement. My recommendation: offer Option 1 as default (minimal ops change) with a short optional credit so she can cover the immediate spike. Proposed language and concessions below. Need quick thumbs-up so I can send the amendment and PO path.

Proposed commercial mechanics: 
- If add 250k units on Nov 27 and term renews Apr 30, pro-rate = (months remaining / 12) * annualized price on uplifted units. For CobaltAI baseline pricing: $0.00030/token unit list. Incremental spend = 250,000 * $0.00030 = $75.00 (per token unit model) — NOTE: using token-units here as consolidated units for simplicity. 
- If we translate to monthly run-rate on uplift (assuming 12-month annualization at renewal): annual cost of uplift = $75 * 12 = $900; monthly = $75. Pro-rate for 5 months remaining (Dec-Apr) = 5/12 * $900 = $375.

Discount credit path: recommend a one-time $10k credit (Option 3) as concession rather than lowering list price. This preserves SLA and avoids precedent-setting permanent discounts. Credit applied to invoices until exhausted.

Cancellation clause: 30-day cancellation window for the uplifted tranche can be added (limited to one exercise) if procurement signs PO and credits are applied. This protects them without changing SLA.

Can you confirm were comfortable approving a $10k one-time credit and the math above? If Ben confirms, Ill send the amendment + DocuSign and copy procurement.

Thanks — Kim

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal + Expansion: staged uplift, co-term alignment, and one-time credit options

Kim / Jordan — Im OK with the $10k one-time credit as a concession on this renewal/expansion. A few guardrails: 
- Credit can only be applied to usage invoices through Q1 2027.
- If CobaltAI sustains >30% delta for two consecutive months after Q1, we escalate to a committed uplift conversation (standard).
- No change to SLA or performance entitlements.

Approve sending amendment with the above. Kim: please include the explicit pro-rate calculation in the one-pager and add the 30-day cancel window language under a short clause titled "Uplift Trial."

Ben
